fullPassage:
Bull Market vs. Bear Market

Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and maintain their investments.

BEAR MARKET
Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.

questions.passage: Bull Market vs. Bear Market Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market. BULL MARKET A bull market is a (A)[rising / falling] stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future (B)[performance / decline]. As such, they increase their stock purchases and (C)[maintain / abandon] their investments.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 강세장은 상승하는 주식시장이다. 투자자들은 시장의 실적을 믿는다. 그래서 투자를 유지한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① rising — decline — maintain: (B) decline(하락)은 상승장 맥락에 부적절.
❌ ② falling — performance — maintain: (A) falling(하락하는)은 상승장과 반대.
✅ ③ rising — performance — maintain: 원문 그대로. ←정답
❌ ④ rising — performance — abandon: (C) abandon(포기하다)은 maintain(유지하다)의 반대.
det.tip: rising(상승하는) ↔ falling. performance(실적) ↔ decline(하락). maintain(유지하다) ↔ abandon(포기하다).

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a (A)[decline / rise] in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience (B)[decreases / increases] in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have (C)[negative / positive] views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 약세장은 주가 하락을 의미한다. 대부분 주식이 가치 감소를 경험한다. 투자자들은 부정적 시각을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① decline — increases — negative: (B) increases(증가)는 약세장에 부적절.
✅ ② decline — decreases — negative: 원문 그대로. ←정답
❌ ③ rise — decreases — negative: (A) rise(상승)는 약세장과 반대.
❌ ④ decline — decreases — positive: (C) positive(긍정적)는 약세장 투자자 심리와 반대.
det.tip: decline(하락) ↔ rise. decreases(감소) ↔ increases. negative(부정적) ↔ positive(긍정적).

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are (A)[favorable / hostile] to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a (B)[charging / retreating] bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock (C)[purchases / sales] and maintain their investments.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 경제 조건이 투자자에게 유리한. 돌진하는 황소를 떠올려라. 주식 매입을 늘린다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① favorable — charging — purchases: 원문 그대로. ←정답
❌ ② hostile — charging — purchases: (A) hostile(적대적인)은 상승장 경제와 반대.
❌ ③ favorable — retreating — purchases: (B) retreating(후퇴하는)은 돌진하는 황소와 반대.
❌ ④ favorable — charging — sales: (C) sales(매도)는 상승장에서 매입의 반대.
det.tip: favorable(유리한) ↔ hostile(적대적인). charging(돌진하는) ↔ retreating(후퇴하는). purchases(매입) ↔ sales(매도).

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are ①<u>favorable</u> to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP ②<u>increases</u>, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they ③<u>reduce</u> their stock purchases and ④<u>maintain</u> their investments.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 경제 조건이 투자자에게 ①유리한. GDP ②증가. 주식 매입을 ③줄인다(→늘린다). 투자를 ④유지한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① favorable: '유리한'은 상승장 조건으로 적절.
✅ ② increases: 'GDP 증가'는 상승장 조건으로 적절.
❌ ③ reduce: 원문은 increase(늘리다). reduce(줄이다)는 상승장에서 매입을 늘린다는 맥락과 부적절. ←정답
✅ ④ maintain: '유지하다'는 투자 유지 맥락에 적절.
det.tip: increase(늘리다) ↔ reduce(줄이다). 상승장에서 투자자는 매입을 늘린다.

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a ①<u>decline</u> in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience ②<u>decreases</u> in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have ③<u>negative</u> views of the stock market, which may lead them to ④<u>purchase</u> their stocks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 주가 ①하락. 가치 ②감소. ③부정적 시각. 주식을 ④구매하다(→팔다).
det.analysis:
✅ ① decline: '하락'은 약세장 설명으로 적절.
✅ ② decreases: '감소'는 약세장 설명으로 적절.
✅ ③ negative: '부정적'은 어려운 경제 상황의 투자자 시각으로 적절.
❌ ④ purchase: 원문은 sell(팔다). purchase(구매하다)는 약세장에서 매도하는 맥락과 부적절. ←정답
det.tip: sell(팔다) ↔ purchase(구매하다). 약세장에서 투자자는 주식을 판다.

questions.passage:
Bull Market vs. Bear Market

Stock market movement can be ①<u>divided</u> into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic ②<u>indicators</u>. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and maintain their investments.

BEAR MARKET
Like a standing bear having ③<u>raised</u> its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising ④<u>unemployment</u>, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 두 추세로 ①나뉠 수 있다. 경제 ②지표. 앞발을 ③치켜든(→내린). ④실업률 상승.
det.analysis:
✅ ① divided: '나누다'는 두 추세를 구분하는 맥락에 적절.
✅ ② indicators: '지표'는 경제 상태를 나타내는 요소로 적절.
❌ ③ raised: 원문은 lowered(내린). raised(치켜든)는 곰이 앞발을 내린다는 비유와 부적절. ←정답
✅ ④ unemployment: '실업률'은 약세장 조건으로 적절.
det.tip: lowered(내린) ↔ raised(치켜든). 곰이 앞발을 내리듯 주가가 하락한다.

questions.passage:

Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are __________ to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 경제 조건이 투자자에게 __________한 상황.
det.analysis:
❌ ① harmful: '해로운'은 상승장 조건과 반대.
❌ ② neutral: '중립적인'은 호조건을 나타내지 않음.
❌ ③ risky: '위험한'은 상승장 맥락과 반대.
✅ ④ favorable: '유리한' — 상승장에서 경제 조건이 투자자에게 유리함. ←정답
det.tip: favorable(유리한) = advantageous. 상승장 = 투자자에게 유리한 경제 조건.

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low __________ are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 낮은 GDP 성장, 상승하는 실업률, 그리고 낮은 __________.
det.analysis:
✅ ① wages: '임금' — 낮은 임금은 약세장 조건. ←정답
❌ ② stocks: '주식'은 low와 함께 쓰이나 조건 나열 맥락에 부적절.
❌ ③ trends: '추세'는 low와 어울리지 않음.
❌ ④ horns: '뿔'은 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: wages(임금). low wages = 낮은 임금. 약세장 3대 조건: 낮은 GDP 성장 + 높은 실업률 + 낮은 임금.

questions.passage:

Stock market movement can be divided into two major __________: bull market vs. bear market.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주식시장의 움직임은 두 가지 주요 __________로 나뉜다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① values: ‘가치’는 주식시장 움직임의 구분에 부적절.
✅ ② trends: ‘추세’ — 상승장과 약세장은 두 가지 주요 추세. ←정답
❌ ③ factors: ‘요인’은 추세의 원인이지 추세 자체가 아님.
❌ ④ conditions: ‘조건’은 추세의 원인이지 추세 자체가 아님.
det.tip: trends(추세) = 시장의 방향성. two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and <u>maintain</u> their investments.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>maintain</u>과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 그래서 주식 매입을 늘리고 투자를 유지한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① expand: '확장하다'는 maintain보다 적극적.
✅ ② keep: maintain = keep = '유지하다'. ←정답
❌ ③ reduce: '줄이다'는 반의어.
❌ ④ transfer: '이전하다'는 의미 다름.
det.tip: maintain = keep = preserve(유지하다). maintain ↔ abandon/quit.

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market <u>implies</u> a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>implies</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 약세장은 주가 하락을 암시한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① prevents: '방지하다'는 의미 다름.
❌ ② confirms: '확인하다'는 암시보다 확정적.
❌ ③ demands: '요구하다'는 의미 다름.
✅ ④ suggests: implies = suggests = '암시하다, 시사하다'. ←정답
det.tip: implies = suggests = indicates(암시하다). imply ↔ state explicitly(명시하다).

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. In difficult economic situations, investors <u>frequently</u> have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>frequently</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 투자자들은 빈번히 부정적 시각을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① rarely: '드물게'는 반의어.
❌ ② gradually: '점차적으로'는 빈도가 아닌 속도.
✅ ③ often: frequently = often = '빈번히, 자주'. ←정답
❌ ④ suddenly: '갑자기'는 빈도가 아닌 속도.
det.tip: frequently = often = regularly(자주). frequently ↔ rarely/seldom.

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are <u>favorable</u> to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>favorable</u>과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 경제 조건이 투자자에게 유리한.
det.analysis:
❌ ① profitable: '수익성 있는'은 유사 의미.
✅ ② adverse: favorable(유리한)의 반의어 = adverse(불리한). ←정답
❌ ③ beneficial: '유익한'은 유사 의미.
❌ ④ suitable: '적합한'은 유사 의미.
det.tip: favorable(유리한) ↔ adverse/unfavorable(불리한). adverse conditions = 불리한 조건.

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a <u>decline</u> in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>decline</u>과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 약세장은 주가 하락을 의미한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① reduction: '감소'는 유사 의미.
❌ ② collapse: '붕괴'는 유사 의미 (더 극단적).
❌ ③ stagnation: '정체'는 감소도 증가도 아닌 상태로 의미축이 다름.
✅ ④ surge: decline(하락)의 반의어 = surge(급등). ←정답
det.tip: decline(하락) ↔ surge/rise(급등). surge = 급격한 상승.

questions.passage:
(A) Stock market <u>movement</u> can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.
(B) The environmental <u>movement</u> gained momentum as more young people joined protests across the country.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 movement의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 주식시장의 움직임. (B) 환경 운동이 탄력을 받았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 움직임 — (B) 운동: (A)는 시장의 물리적/수치적 변동, (B)는 사회적 운동. ←정답
❌ ② (A) 운동 — (B) 움직임: 의미가 뒤바뀜.
❌ ③ (A) 움직임 — (B) 움직임: (B)는 사회운동.
❌ ④ (A) 운동 — (B) 운동: (A)는 시장 변동.
det.tip: movement: (수치) 변동, 움직임 / (사회) 운동. stock market movement vs. social movement.

det.korean: 어떤 것의 상태나 수준을 보여주는 표시나 정보.
det.analysis:
❌ ① investment: '투자'는 상태를 보여주는 것이 아님.
❌ ② employment: '고용'은 특정 현상이지 표시가 아님.
✅ ③ indicator: '지표' = 상태나 수준을 보여주는 표시. ←정답
❌ ④ condition: '조건'은 상태 자체이지 보여주는 표시가 아님.
det.tip: indicator(지표) = 경제 상태를 나타내는 수치/신호. economic indicators = 경제지표.

BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic __________. det.korean: 높은 고용률, GDP 증가, 그리고 기타 긍정적 경제 __________.
det.analysis:
❌ ① situations: '상황'은 other positive economic과 어울리나 지표의 역할 아님.
✅ ② indicators: '지표' — 고용률, GDP 증가 등은 긍정적 경제 지표. ←정답
❌ ③ investments: '투자'는 지표가 아님.
❌ ④ movements: '움직임'은 개별 수치와 어울리지 않음.
det.tip: indicators(지표) = 경제 상태를 측정하는 수치. employment rates, GDP 등이 경제 지표.

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising __________, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 낮은 GDP 성장, 상승하는 __________, 그리고 낮은 임금은 약세장 조건이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① unemployment: ‘실업률’ — 상승하는 실업률은 약세장 조건. ←정답
❌ ② employment: ‘고용’은 rising과 함께 쓰면 ‘상승하는 고용’으로 약세장 조건과 반대.
❌ ③ investment: ‘투자’는 rising과 함께 쓰이는 조건이 아님.
❌ ④ performance: ‘실적’은 약세장 원인 나열과 무관.
det.tip: unemployment(실업률) ↔ employment(고용률). rising unemployment = 상승하는 실업률.
